title: Slice category
description: JSON Schema for a slice category C/A — the category whose objects are morphisms f : X → A in C with target A, and whose morphisms (X, f) → (Y, g) are morphisms h : X → Y in C such that g ∘ h = f (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. II §6; Awodey 2010 §1.6). Specializes category by carrying base-category and over-object cells naming what's being sliced.

base-category.description: The base category C being sliced.

over-object.description: The object A of C over which the slice is taken — the common codomain of the objects of C/A.
